recipe.score: AI logit minus human logit; author ConPara.score with Unicode normalization and whitespace collapse

protocol.selection: All already frozen, scorable, public English inputs passing known V2/V3/XLM-R family exclusion; private and local generation regression excluded.
protocol.overlap_limit: The existing exclusion checks do not audit all new classifiers' training data or foundation-model pretraining. No globally unseen/decontaminated claim.
protocol.source_quality: Keep the previously frozen exclusion of misindexed LLaMA rephrasing from matched primary comparisons; retain AI-only diagnostic separately.
protocol.input_policy: Native documented author policies; unequal context budgets disclosed. Primary cross-model cells use the intersection of supported input IDs.
protocol.old_models: Reuse original frozen V2, XLM-R first-512 scores, and MAGE author-recipe predictions; no rescoring/refitting.
protocol.privacy: Inputs and record-level outputs stay local; public artifacts contain aggregate metrics and protocols only.

bootstrap_unit: paired deduplicated human topic; joint model resampling
thresholds: Published author/native thresholds frozen in protocol; no external-label recalibration.
mage_modes: MAGE author deployment and raw first-4096 are sensitivity modes of ONE detector, not two competitors.
language: English only for this recent-detector expansion; original Chinese results unchanged.
privacy: Aggregate only. No texts, IDs, per-record scores, or private/local-generation cases.

selection_amendment.reason: Replace MELD public mirror with official author-published DeBERTa-ConPara AACL-IJCNLP 2026 checkpoint because mirror/original identity cannot be independently verified. No score-based choice; all V2 inputs, weights and thresholds unchanged.

excluded_candidates: MELD mirror: original/mirror weight identity not independently verifiable; no predictions measured. DivEye original demo: two-GPU reference pipeline exceeds local hardware. ParaTrace selected candidate: gated access.
